path_policy: All asset svg/png/webp paths are relative to this directory. Approved-round-badge reference is relative to assets/v3/manifest.json.
scope: Asset delivery only. Game code and existing approved round badges remain unchanged.

coordinate_system.raster_conversion: Multiply all slot coordinates and font size by target PNG width / view_box[2].

uniform_number_policy.front: Use uniform_sets.*.front for actual player-number overlays; front_sample contains decorative 24.
uniform_number_policy.back: Always blank. Name and number are supplied by the game.
uniform_number_policy.sample_number: 24 is an artwork sample, never roster data.

portrait_policy: No portrait or player-face assets; existing face generation is preserved.
league_wordmark_policy: No provisional league name is printed into the artwork.

gem.editable: Replace named gradient stops; preserve light/dark facets.

safe_area.note: Quiet dark area for game-rendered text; no labels baked in.
No bracket, teams, records or dates baked in.

integration.default_format: SVG where practical; PNG at display size/DPR otherwise. Stage WebP preferred over PNG.
integration.inline_svg: All IDs and url(#...) references are prefixed by asset ID; when inlining the SAME asset twice, add a per-instance prefix too.
integration.color_editing: Named layers/gradients listed in color_tokens. SVG uses ordinary native SVG fills and stops, not parent-page CSS inheritance. PNG colors are baked.
integration.empty_slot_rendering: Blank name/number/record zones contain no placeholder text or visible guide boxes.
integration.not_game_code: No JavaScript, handlers, animation, or binding implementation is included.
